nodes.text: Union Health Minister JP Nadda has responded to rising concerns about Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in India, where seven cases have been reported. In a video message, he reassured citizens, clarifying that HMPV is not a new virus but has been present globally since 2001. https://t.co/zp1ZKqcYOg
